metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:exported_predictor_audit: Optional host-runner audit against a strictly reloaded selected category checkpoint. Reference inference runs on CPU, with at most 32 frozen fixtures and 256 distinct candidates per fixture. Canonical JSON uses sorted keys, UTF-8, compact separators and no NaN. Artifact and fixture hashes identify the frozen manifest, not its correctness. Binary FP32 scores use rtol=1e-5 and atol=1e-6 without adaptive widening. Reference scores are withheld from the runner. CPU-reference versus export-device differences remain subject to these thresholds; no backend calibration is claimed. Relative errors exclude zero reference denominators, whose nonzero errors are counted separately. Robust inversions reverse a reference pair separated by more than the sum of its two permitted errors. Per-fixture ranked IDs and adjacent reference gaps are retained. Loaded configuration/mapping comparisons require explicit runner observations. Auxiliary ranks use descending score then ascending canonical item ID; exact rank disagreements remain visible when score tolerances pass. Missing runner or manifest is unavailable; supplied-path execution, artifact or comparison errors are failures. Runner invocation and loaded-artifact observations are supplied evidence, not independently authenticated process provenance. Internal fault calibration, parameter/buffer parity, deployed readout observation and simulator full-catalog selection remain explicitly uncertified. Wall time is recorded separately from unavailable GPU-time accounting. This audit neither fits another model nor measures held-out recommendation quality.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:consumed_pipeline_audit: At most four explicitly supplied production records. Independently reconstructs crops, source events, reserved-mask corruption, labels and seeded negative draws from public training histories. Same-forward detached logits check pooled CE/BPR scalar reduction without a second forward; tolerances are recorded per dtype. No gradient certification. Calibration uses only the first retained record, verified changed-label and restored-mask faults, plus clean and consistent row-permutation controls. Coverage is detected divided by verified non-equivalent corruptions; zero denominators are null. Repeated-ID shifts are equivalent for the label-only operator. These bounded controls do not estimate real fault prevalence. Captures need not belong to the selected checkpoint. Missing transport, deployment parity and held-out gains remain unavailable. No production iterator is advanced when captured replay is supplied; worker state and exact restart are not certified.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:bert4rec_integrity: Independent appended-mask fixtures compare exact IDs and live candidate scores at rtol=1.3e-6, atol=1e-5. Includes padding perturbation and negative controls. False checks require investigation; unavailable checks are not passes. Synthetic provenance controls do not certify the actual sampler.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal pairwise cosine + 1)/2 over up to 2048 seed-42 sampled catalog embeddings, excluding padding and mask. Measures angular alignment, not recommendation diversity or representation quality by itself.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:embedding_collapse_reason: Reason the collapse statistic is undefined, or null

metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:pos_neg_margin_category_br: Observed batch, invalid-target and low-margin counts. Category lists remain empty because item category metadata is unavailable. The supplied sampler always masks selected targets.
metric_definitions.Movies_and_TV:training_history_sensitivi: One last training target/user with strictly earlier prefix truncated to L-1; earlier repeats are retained. Up to 200 users selected with seed 42. Candidate draws 42/43/44 are reported separately. Rank is one-based with stable candidate-order ties; HR10 is rank<=10; margin is target minus hardest negative. Each delta is intervention minus original. Recent-minus-older is newest-block intervention minus oldest-block intervention; k=min(3,floor(n/2)). Overlap is intersection/minimum returned top-list length. Compact deletion shifts survivor positions; mask replacement retains positions and introduces learned mask content. Attention deletion is unavailable without a supported hook. Means have 1000-resample seed-42 user-bootstrap percentile 95% intervals, conditional on the selected users and candidate draw. These intervals exclude checkpoint-selection uncertainty. Popularity quartiles use catalog training counts; length quartiles use selected retained prefix lengths; tied cutpoints may produce empty strata. Results describe training-exposed sensitivity, not causal preferences, memorization alone or held-out generalization. Host validation is unchanged; no four-category macro is fabricated.
